svg.title: Four summons, four ways to throw flames
svg.desc: The four summons that need one Djinni each draw a small Djinni of their element and throw flames at the enemies. Venus raises ten columns of flame from the ground, one every four frames, each bursting into motes. Mercury's Djinni circles and fires five flames across the screen, each shattering into motes five frames after it leaves. Mars flares an orb, its Djinni dives into the ground and nine flames erupt in a row while embers rise from them. Jupiter drops eight flameballs from the top right, one every four frames, each shattering into motes as it lands. The flames are the effect's own particles; the motes each flame breaks into take a block of 32 places in the borrowed pool. Each card plays the cast as the game draws it, aimed at three of the party standing in as enemies.
